issues.description: Transport errors and timeouts are not retried or wrapped, so transient network failures leak raw httpx exceptions.
Resource IDs are interpolated into URLs without percent-encoding, allowing '/', '?', or '#' to alter path/query semantics.
batch_create eagerly materializes the entire iterable, risking high memory use and contradicting the any-iterable API.
batch_create silently drops malformed result entries and does not verify result count or index coverage.
Pagination trusts next_cursor blindly, so repeated cursors can loop forever and malformed items are silently skipped.
Retry-After only supports numeric seconds and ignores valid HTTP-date headers, causing incorrect retry timing.
Response parsers accept invalid literal statuses/verdicts and inconsistent result states despite typed model claims.
Unconditional str/int/float coercion can hide malformed API data such as null IDs or wrong scalar types.
